title_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1 Me Pamje Fantastike Dhe 2 Poste Parkimi Te Perfshira Ne Cmim!!
description_sq: Ne Fresk, shume afer Unazes se Madhe, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1, ne nje pallat te ri me Ashensor !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e gjashte te nje pallati 7-katesh dhe ka siperfaqe bruto 202 m2, nga e cila siperfaqe neto eshte 143 m2, veranda me siperfaqe 41 m2, e cila eshte e mbyllur me vetrata xhami te cilesise me te mire, siperfaqe perbashket 18 m2 dhe garazh te mbyllur me qepen me sip.30 m2 ( per 2 makina) te perfshire ne cmim. Prona eshte totalisht e investuar nga vete pronari me punime shume cilesore qe nga pjesa e verandes dhe pjesa e brendshme, duke filluar nga sistemi elektrik, sistemi hidraulik, dritaret plastike me izolim perfekt, parket nga me i miri ne treg Parador, kuzhina e ardhur nga Austria, ndricimi led, tualetet, oxhaku ne sallon i cili lidhet me sistemin e kaldajes per ngrohjen e ambientit, panele diellore e deri tek filtrat e ujit. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug-lindje dhe perendim, duke ofruar ndricim dhe diell gjate gjithe dites si dhe nje pamje fantastike nga qyteti. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet prona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode.
title_en: In Freske, Super Apartment 3+1 For Sale With Fantastic View And 2 Parking Spaces Included In The Price!!
description_en: In Fresk, very close to the Great Ring, Super Apartment 3+1 for sale, in a new building with an elevator!! The apartment is located on the sixth floor of a 7-story building and has a gross area of 202 m2, of which the net area is 143 m2, a veranda with an area of 41 m2, which is closed with glass windows of the best quality, a total area of 18 m2 and a garage closed with a shutter of 30 m2 (for 2 cars) included in price The property is fully invested by the owner himself with high-quality works from the veranda and the interior, starting from the electrical system, plumbing system, plastic windows with perfect insulation, parquet from the best in the market Parador, kitchen from Austria, LED lighting, toilets, fireplace in the living room which is connected to the boiler system for heating the environment, solar panels and water filters. The orientation of the apartment is south-east and west, offering light and sun throughout the day as well as a fantastic view of the city. The area in which the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
